scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:lite: npm run db:up && npm run db:wait && npm run dev
scripts.dev:stack: npm run db:up && npm run db:wait && npm run migrate && npm run dev
scripts.dev:api:stack: npm run db:up && npm run migrate && npm run dev:api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @us-vibe/backend && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web && npm run lint -w api
scripts.test: npm run test -w web && npm run test -w api
